basic_info.description: This incredible 2BR/1.5BA luxurious condo in a 2-unit prime Nob Hill location has amazing amenities and views that will take your breath away!  This stunning top floor, two-level unit provides exceptional entertaining space with high ceilings, floor-to-ceiling windows providing abundant natural light. The main level includes a spacious open floor plan with remodeled kitchen, breakfast bar and dining area. Direct access to a deck with these amazing views including Mt. Tam, Marin & Golden Gate Bridge view.The lower level includes a primary air-conditioned suite, a walk-in closet, recessed dimmable lighting and luxurious bathroom. The second bedroom, powder room and storage closet complete this level. A deeded 2-car garage and an incredible amount of in-unit & garage storage, add comfort to your lifestyle. With a walk score of 98, enjoy Hyde St. dining, shops and iconic cable car access. Walk to the shops and restaurants on Polk and Union Streets. A captivating San Francisco remodeled condo that feels like single family home! Views, 2 car garage, and deeded roof rights with stunning views - what more can you ask for?? Move right in.
